evidence: Reporting leading into May 13, 2022, reflects severe crypto market stress driven by the systemic collapse of Terra (LUNA/UST) and subsequent liquidation cascades. Articles highlight intense selling pressure, including record-level BTC inflows to exchanges signaling potential dumping, multiple liquidations surpassing $1.28 billion, and technical breakdowns testing sub-$27,000 to $28,000 support levels. While longer-term structural items (favorable German tax rules, Shanghai court property rights affirmation) were reported, immediate 24-hour market sentiment is dominated by panic and acute downside risk.
limitations: All available evidence originates from unverified free crypto news sources rather than authenticated Yahoo Finance reporting.
Multiple articles cover identical underlying events (e.g., German tax clarification, Shanghai court ruling, MicroStrategy paper losses) and were deduplicated in impact.
Extreme market volatility during the Terra/UST collapse can create rapid sentiment reversals not fully captured by static news coverage.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
reference_price_definition: Binance BTCUSDT daily candle close at the contract timestamp
